name: motionplay
description: A motion-controlled racket-sports console. The laptop plays the game and a phone is the controller.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @motionplay/shared && npm run build -w @motionplay/controller-engine && concurrently -k -n shared,controller,server,web -c cyan,blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @motionplay/shared" "npm run dev -w @motionplay/controller-engine" "npm run dev -w @motionplay/server" "npm run dev -w @motionplay/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @motionplay/shared && npm run build -w @motionplay/controller-engine && npm run build -w @motionplay/server && npm run build -w @motionplay/web
scripts.start: npm run build -w @motionplay/shared && npm run build -w @motionplay/controller-engine && concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,green "npm run start -w @motionplay/server" "npm run start -w @motionplay/web"
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @motionplay/shared && npm run build -w @motionplay/controller-engine && npm run lint -w @motionplay/web && npm run typecheck -w @motionplay/server && npm run typecheck -w @motionplay/shared && npm run typecheck -w @motionplay/controller-engine
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @motionplay/shared && npm run build -w @motionplay/controller-engine && npm run typecheck -w @motionplay/shared && npm run typecheck -w @motionplay/controller-engine && npm run typecheck -w @motionplay/server && npm run typecheck -w @motionplay/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @motionplay/shared && npm run test -w @motionplay/server && npm run test -w @motionplay/shared && npm run test -w @motionplay/controller-engine && npm run test -w @motionplay/web
